messages:
Marta: heads-up: promote stuck in verify after a background index prune overlapped with prefetch. deploybot returns manifest 412s.
Ibrahim: saw it. small subset of manifests missing during verify. logs show index delete and immediate read.
Eve: paste log snippet:
```
2026-05-10T09:14:02Z index: delete /shard-5/manifest/sha256:aa11...
2026-05-10T09:14:03Z verify: read manifest sha256:aa11... -> 412
2026-05-10T09:14:04Z deploybot: verify retry attempt=2 id=sha256:aa11...
2026-05-10T09:14:04Z deploybot: verify queue backlog=27
```
ci-bot: last-known-good (sha256:5566) passed full matrix earlier, smoke ok.
Marta: change window closes in 35m. Options: pin to sha256:5566 (fast) or run shard-repair (longer).
Ibrahim: recommend pin to preserve window, then follow up with prune quiesce and repair automation.
Eve: +1. if pin still blocked, fallback reduce VERIFY_CONCURRENCY to 1 to let verifies drain.
Marta: executing manual promote in 90s unless objections.
deploybot: promote request accepted. skipping prefetch. verify queued on runner-4.
deploybot: verify passed on runner-4 id=sha256:5566. rollout started.
deploybot: rollout complete. release window kept.
Marta: release note: "Pinned to last-known-good due to artifact-index prune overlapping prefetch causing manifest verify failures. Follow-ups: pre-prune quiesce, shard-repair task, alert for verify-queue spikes."
Ibrahim: filing tickets ART-1333, INFRA-221. attaching logs.
Marta: thanks all, closing thread.
